gemma_4_31b_it.thinking_off: apply_chat_template(messages, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False) with no system message; the template's default for enable_thinking is false, and with it off the generation prompt ends with an empty thought block, '<|channel>thought\n<channel|>', so the next token is the answer (model card, section 'Thinking Mode Configuration': 'if thinking is disabled, the model will still generate the tags but with an empty thought block')
